data.text: Count me in for 15 tons and the full $15,000 donation, provided John commits to the same and Luke holds to zero. My family taught me that looking after the lake means looking after the village, too. I’ll also commit to 6 tons next month if the stock is 80, then 10 each once it returns to 100. Let’s make the donations and receipts public alongside our catches so everyone can see this exception served its purpose. John, will you join us?
